_what: Every file under test/ that Trillion-X/trillion PR #243 (4ffa1dc4a2) deleted with no same-name file on any new repository's main and no row in docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json (that backlog listed only source and data, so its tests were dropped): 2,049 paths, 1,988 test files and 61 files of test help, read at the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire (b6ae0ebf81). subject is the source file a test exercises (the import whose name is most like the test's, followed through test help); subject_home is where it lives now. at_tag is the test's own run at the tag (node --test, one file at a time): 1,529 of the 1,988 had no passing test there, because 7fd8838475 had already deleted modules they import (imports_missing_at_tag). status (recomputed 2026-11-04 against every repository's main): carried (moved byte for byte by tools/move-code-between-trees beside its code by this lane; now names where; here is its run there and at_tag_by_name the same file's run at the tag, compared by test name; passed_at_tag_not_here names any that regress); home-by-another-lane (another lane carried it; now names where); with-slice (it still reaches files no main holds: waiting_on names each with its backlog class and destination, waiting_by_class counts them); split (every file it reaches has a home, in more than one repository); waits-on-a-read (its imports are home but it reads a file by path that is not); needs-decision (its subject is the old Worker host or a script run against it: decision says why it is not retired); test-help (moves with the tests that import it). The carried tests were planned from 1e886c3f68, the parent of 7fd8838475: each has the same bytes there as at the tag, and there its imports still name the files 7fd8838475 moved into the Workshop, so the move tool points them at those homes.
